purpose.en: The bring-up stage of kirimasim that each test needs, so that its progress shows stage by stage, and a short set of representatives for each stage. The stages order parts of UVM; they are not the M1 to M4 milestones and change no expectation.
purpose.ja: 各テストに必要なkirimasimの立ち上げ段階と、段階ごとの代表の短いセット。進み具合を段階ごとに見えるようにする。段階はUVMの部分の順序で、milestone M1〜M4とは別で、期待値を変えない。

description.en: The simulator compiles and elaborates uvm_pkg and runs its static initialization; the test uses only package-scope declarations, such as enumeration values, and creates no UVM object.
description.ja: simulatorがuvm_pkgをcompile・elaborateし、静的初期化を実行する。テストはenum値などpackage scopeの宣言だけを使い、UVM objectを作らない。

description.en: Objects and components, run_test, the phases, objections and reports. This is the stage of every test that uses no marker of a later stage.
description.ja: objectとcomponent、run_test、phase、objection、report。後の段階のmarkerを使わないテストは、すべてこの段階になる。

description.en: Explicit use of the factory: type_id, type and instance overrides, object wrappers, and creation by name or by type.
description.ja: factoryを明示的に使う：type_id、型とinstanceのoverride、object wrapper、名前や型による生成。

description.en: The configuration and resource databases: uvm_config_db, uvm_resource_db, resources and the resource pool, and automatic configuration.
Sequences run on sequencers and drivers: sequences and sequence libraries, sequencers, drivers, start_item and finish_item, and the sequence macros. A sequence item alone does not place a test here.
description.ja: sequencerとdriverの上でsequenceを動かす：sequenceとsequence library、sequencer、driver、start_itemとfinish_item、sequenceのmacro。sequence itemだけを使うテストは、この段階にならない。

description.en: TLM: ports, exports and imps, analysis ports, FIFOs and channels, TLM 2 sockets and payloads, the imp declaration macros, subscribers and comparators.
description.ja: TLM：port・export・imp、analysis port、FIFOとchannel、TLM 2のsocketとpayload、impの宣言macro、subscriberとcomparator。

description.en: The register layer: register blocks, registers, fields, maps, memories, virtual registers, adapters, predictors, register sequences and HDL access. Typedefs such as uvm_reg_data_t alone do not place a test here.
description.ja: register層：register block、register、field、map、memory、仮想register、adapter、predictor、registerのsequence、HDL access。uvm_reg_data_tなどのtypedefだけを使うテストは、この段階にならない。

reason.en: Written for stage 0: the module only imports uvm_pkg and names one enumeration value, so it creates no UVM object and does not call run_test.
reason.ja: 段階0のために書いたテスト。moduleはuvm_pkgをimportして1つのenum値を名指しするだけで、UVM objectを作らず、run_testを呼ばない。
